notes: Authored 2026-09-29 before the change (night goal). A number right after a password/PIN label (비밀번호, 핀 번호, PIN 번호, 비번, 암호, with particles) is read digit by digit like other labeled identifiers: a password is never a quantity. A counted number after the label (4자리) and an unlabeled number are guards. Provisional project policy, pending independent linguistic review.
